# NestNook

> NestNook is a US blog about renter-friendly smart homes: 108 no-drill, deposit-safe guides for apartments and small homes, covering lighting, no-drill security, climate, kitchen gadgets, small spaces and budget setups under $100. Every guide states cost, setup time, tools and landlord-safe removal notes.

NestNook helps US renters and small-home owners enjoy smart-home comfort without drilling, rewiring or risking a security deposit. All 108 guides live on the single-page site below, organised into 7 categories with search and filters; each guide opens as a full article with steps, a budget table, landlord-safe notes and FAQs.

## Guide categories

- [Start Here](https://nestnook.site/#categories): First devices, setup order and the renter rules that protect your deposit — including building a smart home in a small apartment for under $100.
- [Lighting](https://nestnook.site/#categories): Smart bulbs, LED strips and lamps that transform a rental in minutes, with no hub and no wiring.
- [Security — No-Drill](https://nestnook.site/#categories): No-drill video doorbells, peephole cameras, stick-on sensors and smart locks with zero screws.
- [Climate & Air](https://nestnook.site/#categories): Smart fans, purifiers, humidity and thermostat alternatives that never touch landlord-owned systems.
- [Kitchen & Dining](https://nestnook.site/#categories): Small-kitchen smart gadgets, leak sensors and voice-controlled cooking help that earn their counter space.
- [Small Spaces](https://nestnook.site/#categories): Studio and tiny-home layouts, storage, TV and work-from-home setups for small footprints.
- [Budget & Deals](https://nestnook.site/#categories): Under-$25 upgrades, under-$50 security kits, deal playbooks and honest subscription advice.

## Key pages

- [All 108 guides](https://nestnook.site/#library): Search and filter the full guide library.
- [Starter Kit Builder](https://nestnook.site/#kitbuilder): Interactive widget that builds a no-drill starter kit for a chosen budget and priority.
- [The weekend plan](https://nestnook.site/#start): A 3-step path to a first smart home — light it up, see the door, automate the rest.
- [About NestNook](https://nestnook.site/#about): What NestNook is, who it is for, and the deposit-safe promise behind every guide.

- [Privacy Policy](https://nestnook.site/privacy.html): What data NestNook collects (very little), cookies and Google advertising, affiliate links.
- [Contact NestNook](https://nestnook.site/contact.html): Report a correction or broken link, request a guide, or ask about a partnership — via WhatsApp.
- [Best Video Doorbells for Apartments (Black Friday 2026)](https://nestnook.site/best-video-doorbell-for-apartment.html): No-drill doorbell picks for renters, with verified prices, package-theft plan and smart-lock picks.
- [Best Smart Home Hub for Renters (November 2026)](https://nestnook.site/best-smart-home-hub-renters-november-2026/): Apple HomeView vs Echo Dot 2026 vs Google Home Speaker — the three new renter-friendly hubs, compared for apartments.
